label: Lawn care
lede: Mowing, edging, trimming and cleanups for lawns and beds. Tell us about your yard and we'll send you a price.

services.Mowing & edging: Lawn cut, walks and driveway edged, clippings blown off.
services.Hedge & shrub trimming: Hedges squared up and shrubs shaped.
services.Palm trimming: Dead fronds and seed pods taken down and hauled away.
services.Mulch & rock: Beds weeded and topped with fresh mulch, shell or stone.
services.Yard cleanups: Overgrown lots, storm debris and leaves cleared out.
services.Sod & planting: Dead patches replaced and new plants set in.
services.Weed control: Weeds pulled or treated in lawns, beds and paver joints.
services.Irrigation checks: Heads, zones and timers checked and adjusted.
